reason: The tanks need refrigeration to store the propellants as liquids, and the chapter describes matched vessels and cooling units.
expectation: The cooling units will equip the tanks for separate cryogenic storage.

effect: The two tanks now have separate refrigeration and keyed fittings, so they can be connected to their respective propellant supplies.
reaction: The separate fittings make the safety arrangement clear.
reason: The purified methane supply can feed the methane-labeled refrigerated tank.
expectation: Methane will be liquefied and collected in its own tank.

effect: Methane is now collected as a liquid; the oxygen store still needs filling.
reaction: The first liquid is a clear step toward the two-store goal.
reason: The remaining refrigerated tank should connect to the oxygen service outlet.
expectation: Oxygen will be liquefied and collected separately from the methane.

effect: Both propellants are now stored separately; the remaining goal is to coordinate their controls.
reaction: The dedicated oxygen connections make the separation clear.
reason: The two stores are the visible components whose operating controls need linking.
expectation: Their controllers will be linked without connecting the propellant flow paths.

effect: The linked controls completed the fuel fabrication system while keeping the propellant circuits separate; all chapter goals are complete.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the two stores become a working installation without compromising their separation.

mostWorthwhile.text: Linking the stores was the most worthwhile action: it brought the separate equipment together into an installation able to supply the ascent tanks, with a clear explanation of what was and was not connected.

leastWorthwhile.text: Filling the two tanks was somewhat repetitive, although the distinct oxygen-clean fittings gave the second connection a practical purpose.

surprise.text: The final combination joined operating controls rather than the propellants themselves; the result made that distinction explicit.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary. The visible goal and equipment made each connection understandable, though the matching tank-and-cooler combination was fairly predictable.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the separate cooling and flow paths made the engineering understandable, and I would be curious to see how the fuel supports the return.
